🚨 Hiring: QA Lead | 8+ Years
📍 Bangalore Only | Hybrid 
We’re looking for an experienced QA Lead to drive end-to-end testing for an enterprise modernization program.
Must Have:
• 8+ years QA/Test Engineering + leadership experience
• Playwright / Cypress / Selenium
• REST API Automation & Contract Testing
• CI/CD & Quality Gates
• Functional, Integration, Regression & Performance Testing
• Defect Management & Release Governance
Good to Have: .NET / React | Industrial/IoT Testing | Enterprise Modernization
📩 Interested candidates can share their updated CV at hiring@alpha-consultants.in
